question: Among patients older than 55 on 2026-10-09 who have at least one abnormal PT result, what percentage are female? Round to two decimals.
evidence: For this task, PT of at least 14 is abnormal.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) FROM Patient AS p WHERE p.Birthday < '1971-10-09' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.PT >= 14)

expected.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) FROM Patient AS p WHERE p.Birthday < '1971-10-09' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.PT >= 14)
expected.evidence: For this task, PT of at least 14 is abnormal.
